# The two-machine link out of the code (README step 178): --remote, --serve, hip/peer.h, the runtime's peer branches,
# the clock samples in --trace. The layer range (--layers with --teacher, --stream-in/--stream-out) is still there.
# Commit efa4e03 + this step's change (the commit that adds this file); llama.cpp e626db7ca in ~/projects/llama.cpp;
# 2026-11-22 12:47 to 13:45, the machine booted at 12:08.
# GPU clock: level 6 on the four GPUs, set by hand (manual) at 12:47. In this boot the starred level of pp_dpm_sclk reads
# 1 (1000 MHz) whenever a GPU idles and 6 (1608 MHz) while it works (sampled during a run), so the records of these runs
# and run_matrix.py's header say "sclk 1 1 1 1": they read the star as a run starts. The speeds below are level 6's.
# "base" = the programs of efa4e03, built in a second checkout at another path.
# M=~/llms/UD-Q8_K_XL/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-UD-Q8_K_XL-00001-of-00009.gguf  F8=~/llms/ds-1017-fp8/dense-fp8.gguf
# D=~/llms/dspark/dspark-DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-BF16.gguf
#
# 1. Build: make, make HIP=1: rc 0, no warnings in what was rebuilt (the runtime's files and the programs; not hip/fp8_gemv.hip).
#    Code and scripts: 30 lines added, 376 removed. bin-hip/ds-completion 17,194,976 -> 17,129,816 bytes.
#
# 2. The options are gone
bin-hip/ds-completion -m $M --rt $F8 -p hi --remote h:1      unknown argument --remote (rc 2)
bin-hip/ds-completion -m $M --rt $F8 -p hi --serve 7001      unknown argument --serve (rc 2)
bin-hip/ds-completion -m $M --rt $F8 --layers 0-19 -p hi     --layers: a part of the model runs only with --teacher (--stream-in, --stream-out)
#
# 3. Per layer and end to end, the new build against base

# 4. The CPU reference path (apps/ds_completion.cpp is its source too)

# 5. A range of layers still equals the whole model (results/split/teacher.txt's check, cpp-matrix, static placement)
#    T = "<｜User｜>" + the prompt + "<｜Assistant｜></think>" + results/cache-test/plain-canon-static/cpp-matrix.out
#    RUN = bin-hip/ds-completion -m $M --rt $F8 --placement placements/study30.txt --canon -f T --teacher
RUN > ids.full ; RUN --layers 0-19 --stream-out s.bin ; RUN --layers 20-39 --stream-in s.bin > ids.back      cmp ids.full ids.back: identical, 325 positions
